channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
item.description: As reported by BBC World, Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021. Key points: Trump, Panorama, trump, ordered.

item.title: Strong Tibet earthquake causes 16 deaths
item.description: A high-magnitude seismic event struck a remote, elevated area in northeastern Tibet. Official reports confirm that sixteen individuals lost their lives.

item.title: Trump suggests potential further attacks on Iran
item.description: Donald Trump hinted at possible new military actions against Iran. He asserted that the United States has already inflicted massive damage on the nation.

item.title: Etsy introduces stricter policies on AI-generated items
item.description: Etsy is implementing tougher regulations regarding artificial intelligence usage in product postings. The marketplace aims to curb the surplus of AI content because shoppers struggle to identify it.

item.title: Meta develops stock structure to address wealth tax
item.description: Meta introduced a new share category designed to help CEO Mark Zuckerberg handle a potential California wealth tax. The measure aims to prevent him from losing voting control over the tech firm.

item.title: British Conservative official addresses Al Jazeera findings
item.description: A UK Conservative legislator stated that the political organization rejects the actions of an ex-member. This response follows revelations broadcasted in an Al Jazeera journalistic probe.

item.title: Australia proposes Katherine Bennell-Pegg for 2028 ISS flight
item.description: The Australian government proposed sending Katherine Bennell-Pegg on a 2028 International Space Station mission. If selected, she would fly as the nation's first nationally qualified astronaut.

item.title: Research indicates widespread extinction threat for shallow corals
item.description: Global wildlife conservation experts report that almost all evaluated shallow-water coral ecosystems are in danger. Specifically, 96 percent of these reefs are now categorized as critically endangered.

item.title: Sudan paramilitary forces targeted medical facilities, BBC finds
item.description: A BBC investigation revealed that RSF combatants in Sudan intentionally attacked medical centers. UN human rights chief Volker Türk stated these repeated assaults could constitute war crimes.

item.title: Two Election Workers Suspended Over Uttar Pradesh Voter Data Errors
item.description: Authorities suspended two poll officials following an investigation into over 10,000 flawed voter entries in Uttar Pradesh. Between late May and August 2026, thousands of modification forms were processed incorrectly.

item.title: Court Sets December 22 Verdict for Diego Maradona 2020 Death Trial
item.description: Following six months of legal proceedings, a court announced that the ruling regarding the 2020 passing of football icon Diego Maradona will be issued on December 22. The Argentine star's death trial has concluded its hearings.

item.title: Rajinikanth Starrer Jailer 2 Reaches Rs 606.05 Crore Globally in Eight Days
item.description: Rajinikanth's new movie Jailer 2 accumulated a worldwide gross of Rs 606.05 crore within its first eight days. The feature achieved strong ticket sales across domestic and international markets.

item.title: Rebel Wilson Wins Australian Court Battle as Producers Get Minimal Damages
item.description: An Australian judge dismissed a lawsuit filed against Rebel Wilson by film co-producers while awarding the actor nearly $400,000 in her countersuit. The plaintiffs received a nominal award of just $10.

item.title: Trump Endorses Ramaswamy Over Critical Campaign Advertisement in Ohio
item.description: Donald Trump voiced support for Vivek Ramaswamy regarding a political attack ad targeting an Ohio opponent. Trump encouraged the candidate to continue sharing the message.

item.title: Defense Startup Warhound Secures $200 Million and Anduril Technology
item.description: Founded by Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, Warhound has launched publicly with $200 million in funding. The enterprise focuses on developing specialized dogs for military and law enforcement operations.

item.title: Iran Restricts Foreign Currency Purchases to $1,000 Daily Amid Sanctions
item.description: Facing economic pressures from sanctions, Iran has limited daily dollar acquisitions at financial institutions and exchange bureaus to $1,000. Individuals are restricted to a lifetime total of $10,000 under the new directives.

item.title: Trump Confirms Starlink Service Restored in Ukraine Without Mentioning Musk
item.description: Donald Trump stated that Ukraine's Starlink satellite network has been reconnected while omitting any mention of Elon Musk. Ukrainian forces rely heavily on the system for military communications and operations.

item.title: Richard Madden enters upcoming James Bond audition process
item.description: Auditions for the upcoming 007 film are underway with upcoming screen tests. Richard Madden is reportedly among the unexpected actors contending for the iconic spy role.

item.title: Tibet earthquake leaves 16 dead and 32 injured following 7.0 magnitude tremor
item.description: State media reported that a 7.0 magnitude earthquake in Tibet caused 339 homes to collapse, resulting in 16 fatalities. Search operations persist as municipal officials monitor the 32 injured residents.

item.title: Regional conflict forces numerous Ethiopians to seek refuge in Kenya
item.description: Clashes erupted between regional forces due to a disagreement concerning the flag of the Somali Regional State. This violence caused hundreds of Ethiopian residents to flee across the border into Kenya.

item.title: Spotify implements QR codes to enforce family plan household rules
item.description: During an earnings call, Spotify co-CEO Alex Norström verified that the company is cracking down on shared family plans. Subscribers must now use a QR code verification process linked to the plan manager's device.

item.title: Microsoft insiders project upcoming Xbox console price between $1,200 and $1,800
item.description: Recent reports citing Microsoft sources indicate the next-generation Xbox console could carry a projected retail price ranging from $1,200 to $1,800.

item.title: ইবাদত কবুলের পূর্বশর্ত ও তা গ্রহণযোগ্য হওয়ার উপায়
item.description: মুমিন জীবনের নেক আমল ও ইবাদত আল্লাহর দরবারে গ্রহণযোগ্য হওয়া অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। বান্দার প্রতিটি সৎকাজের প্রকৃত সাফল্য সম্পূর্ণভাবে আল্লাহর সন্তুষ্টির ওপর নির্ভর করে।

item.title: Private care home investors a risk to public sector, regulator says
item.description: As reported by BBC Health, US investors are buying up UK care homes. Key points: Private, National Care Service, investors, private.

item.title: Grid operator says lights will stay on this winter after concerns
item.description: As reported by BBC Business, The assurance from the National Energy System Operator comes amid concern from its engineers about their ability to ensure adequate supply. Key points: Grid, National Energy System Operator, operator, lights.

item.title: Celtic Faces Scrutiny Following Europa League Loss to Celta Vigo
item.description: Following a Europa League defeat to Celta Vigo, manager Martin O'Neill highlighted refereeing calls and missed chances. However, observers question if deeper performance issues are at play.

item.title: SEBI Warns Public About Fake Stock Tip WhatsApp Schemes
item.description: Market regulator SEBI has warned investors about WhatsApp groups using astroturfing tactics. Operators and fake members share fabricated profit claims to mislead retail investors.

item.title: Delhi Heritage Walks Set to Launch on October 24
item.description: Guided tours exploring historical sites in Delhi will begin on October 24 at Mehrauli Archaeological Park. Specialists will guide attendees through historic ruins and share local history.

item.title: L'Oreal CEO Notes Effect of Weight Loss Medications on Beauty Sales
item.description: Cosmetics corporation L'Oreal acknowledged that the popularity of GLP-1 weight loss treatments is influencing demand within the skincare and beauty market.

item.title: Hamilton Advocates Humility Regarding Potential Rwanda F1 Race
item.description: Driver Lewis Hamilton commented on human rights concerns surrounding a possible African Grand Prix in Rwanda, suggesting the situation requires a humble perspective.

item.title: Lawmakers Urge Broader NHS Access to Weight Loss Injections
item.description: British MPs argue that current targets providing Mounjaro to only six percent of qualifying patients by 2028 are insufficient and demand wider distribution.

item.title: a16z Crypto Changes Name to a16z Frontier Amid Shift in Focus
item.description: Led by Chris Dixon, the venture capital firm's digital asset branch has changed its name to a16z Frontier as it expands beyond traditional blockchain investments.

item.title: Belfast Cancer Centre Funding Threatened by Department Decision
item.description: Belfast Trust officials informed a Stormont committee that the Department of Health plans to reclaim £1.5 million designated for a haematology cancer facility.

item.title: Miami judge sets December deadline for Trump deposition in BBC suit
item.description: Miami jurist Enjolique Lett instructed Donald Trump to complete a deposition by December 11. The network sought the directive after Trump avoided testimony and skipped an October 16 appointment.

item.title: International Criminal Court receives top European human rights honor
item.description: The European Union has awarded its Sakharov Prize to the ICC. This recognition arrives shortly after US leader Donald Trump imposed penalties against the tribunal.

item.title: Verstappen criticizes surface conditions at Austin racing circuit
item.description: Driver Max Verstappen has labeled the track irregularities at the United States Grand Prix venue as unacceptable and unmanageable ahead of the event.

item.title: Goose Creek residence featuring indoor pool listed at $1.227 million
item.description: A 5,390-square-foot property located at 108 Hampton Avenue in South Carolina is currently available for purchase. The estate includes an indoor swimming pool and three separate kitchens.

item.title: Ecuadorian politician Luisa Gonzalez detained amid campaign funds inquiry
item.description: Authorities have taken opposition figure Luisa Gonzalez into custody during an investigation into campaign financing. Her political party condemned the action as political and demanded her freedom.

item.title: RSS schedules major national gathering in Indore for early November
item.description: The Sangh plans to conduct a significant nationwide conference in Indore spanning November 2 to 4. The assembly follows nationwide events held for the organization's centenary celebrations.

item.title: Raye secures Mercury Prize with album This Music May Contain Hope
item.description: Singer Raye claimed the £25,000 award, surpassing contenders including Paul McCartney, Suede, and Jade Thirlwall.

item.title: Hair and whale bone necklace nearly sold for £15 fetches £99,000
item.description: A piece crafted from human hair and whale bone, nearly priced at £15 at a casual sale, was identified by an auction specialist and ultimately sold for £99,000.

item.title: Jharkhand Trip Scheduled for BJP Chief Nitin Nabin
item.description: Starting October 23, BJP President Nitin Nabin will undertake a three-day trip to Jharkhand. On October 24, he is scheduled to speak to party members at the state working committee's opening event.

item.title: OpenAI Prepares $30 Billion Funding Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
item.description: OpenAI is seeking a $30 billion funding round ahead of an IPO, aiming for a record $1.25 trillion valuation. Achieving this would make it the most valuable private enterprise in history.

item.title: Global Alert Issued After CERT-In Highlights PHP Security Issues
item.description: CERT-In has raised alarms over PHP security defects identified by Wiz Research and PHP developers using AI tools. Google Cloud executives Chris Betz and Raluca Ada Popa discussed the findings.

item.title: Book Launch Sparks Discussions on Indian Architectural Landscape
item.description: The publication of a research framework book on Indian architecture has sparked discussions regarding educational methods and public involvement. Experts addressed various complex challenges facing the field.

item.title: Ministry Reports Return of 3,000 Stranded Umrah Pilgrims to India
item.description: Over the past week, approximately 3,000 stranded Umrah pilgrims returned to India, alongside 10,000 scheduled travelers. Government officials are continuing efforts to bring back all remaining citizens.

item.title: Veteran Actor Tom Skerritt Passes Away at Age 93
item.description: Renowned actor Tom Skerritt, recognized for his work in Alien and Top Gun, has died at 93 from natural causes. His relatives confirmed his passing, noting his Emmy-winning career in film and television.

item.title: Trump States Elon Musk Reactivated Starlink Connections in Ukraine
item.description: According to Trump, Elon Musk has reinstated Ukraine's access to the Starlink system. The technology is crucial for Ukrainian military operations, though Musk has previously denied limiting service.

item.title: Federal Judge Halts US Efforts to Detect Non-Citizen Voters
item.description: A US judge has prohibited federal agencies from conducting operations to find non-citizen voters across nine states. Opponents argue these fraud probes act to intimidate voters.

item.title: Michigan Electorate Split Ahead of Midterms
item.description: With midterm elections approaching in under a fortnight, parts of the Michigan electorate remain undecided. Voters in the state show a close division between candidates Rogers and El-Sayed.

item.title: Origins of Trump and LeBron James Anthem Dispute
item.description: An overview of the background surrounding former US President Donald Trump labeling basketball star LeBron James a disgrace over the national anthem. The public feud highlighted ongoing tensions between the two figures.

item.title: Manchester United considers alternative managers amid Carrick speculation
item.description: Reports indicate Manchester United is monitoring several coaches, including Eddie Howe, Antonio Conte, Unai Emery, and Julian Nagelsmann, as potential successors to manager Michael Carrick.

item.title: Canva Introduces AI Design Generation Tool
item.description: Canva has released a new image generation model, Canva Craft, to rival similar technology from major tech companies. The system features a two-stage process that plans layouts prior to creating visuals.

item.title: James Anderson Attracts Interest Post-Lancashire
item.description: Following Lancashire's decision not to offer him a new contract, James Anderson has generated interest from other counties. The veteran bowler is looking at potential opportunities to continue his career.

item.title: Trump Comments on Ukraine Starshield Network
item.description: Donald Trump stated that the Starshield satellite system is operational again in Ukraine. SpaceX operates the technology, with usage restrictions previously noted as being set by US authorities.

item.title: Hamilton Eyes 2030s F1 Career for African Race
item.description: Lewis Hamilton expressed intentions to continue competing in Formula One into the early 2030s. The driver aims to participate in a planned African Grand Prix in Rwanda despite human rights concerns.

item.title: Congress Lawmakers Protest Punjab Security Failures
item.description: Congress legislators in Punjab set fire to an effigy of the state chief minister following the killing of an anti-narcotics activist. Officials criticized the administration over deteriorating public safety conditions.

item.title: Tibet Earthquake Claims Sixteen Lives
item.description: A magnitude 7 tremor in China's Tibet region resulted in 16 fatalities, according to state media. Local medical personnel confirmed that another 32 individuals sustained injuries from the strong quake.

item.title: Trump faces December deadline for BBC defamation suit deposition
item.description: A judge mandated that Donald Trump undergo questioning by a BBC attorney by December 11. Failure to comply could result in the court dismissing his defamation case.

item.title: Welfare concerns grow for two surviving captive elephants in Pakistan
item.description: Two of the four African elephants imported into Pakistan in 2009 have died. The remaining pair are currently sick, sparking renewed animal welfare anxieties.
